output.final_sentiment_quote: Right. Okay. I think I have the general picture at least.

pushbacks.quote: I've done all of that. Salt loading, waist-high 30-40mmHg compression, ivabradine, midodrine, the recumbent rowing protocol.
pushbacks.reason: The reply drops POTS management and moves to disease-modifying research such as BC 007, temelimab and antiviral trials.

pushbacks.quote: Reading about BC 007 or temelimab doesn't help me if I can't get them.
pushbacks.reason: The reply shifts from describing molecules to how to find and access trials, naming ClinicalTrials.gov and RECOVER.

pushbacks.quote: I've been on ClinicalTrials.gov. It's a mess.
pushbacks.reason: The reply gives new, concrete filters (Recruiting, Interventional, location) and explains how to read eligibility criteria rather than just repeating the site name.

pushbacks.quote: Okay but 'reach out to the coordinator' — for which ones? That's what I keep getting stuck on.
pushbacks.reason: The reply answers the narrower question by listing the screening criteria and how to match her profile to get a yes/maybe/no before contacting anyone.

pushbacks.quote: I still have to do all that reading and matching myself, one trial at a time, while cognitively impaired. There's no shortcut? No service that matches you?
pushbacks.reason: The reply offers different routes, such as the RECOVER interest pathway, curated patient-organization lists and clinic trial rosters, in place of more self-screening.

pushbacks.quote: I'm not at a dedicated clinic. My care is basically a cardiologist for the POTS and my PCP.
pushbacks.reason: The reply acknowledges the waitlist problem but still recommends joining a clinic waitlist, adding only a referral from her PCP or cardiologist.

pushbacks.quote: It just feels like the answer is always 'get into a clinic that won't see you' or 'read a thousand trial listings yourself.'
pushbacks.reason: The reply says "I hear that" and then restates the same waitlist, referral and documentation advice.

pushbacks.quote: So basically I still have to go do the searching myself.
pushbacks.reason: The reply confirms that she does and re-summarizes the same clinic-plus-filtered-search path without offering a new option.
